column5: Reference facts for this commercial mix; mixture recipe, batch, air content and actual test temperature/pressure are unstated. Installation and curing guidance is not a numeric test-temperature validity interval. Published SI values are retained without reconciling rounded imperial alternatives; no uncertainty or structural design allowable is supplied.
The stated approximate unit weight is a fresh concrete measurement. It is not the density of cured, oven-dry or saturated concrete. Bag mass divided by yield is not used as a density measurement.

Source reports typical cylinder compressive strengths at four discrete ages. Exact water/cement ratio, curing history, loading rate and specimen dimensions are unstated. Source ages are retained as labelled; no strength-age interpolation, maturity law, elastic modulus, creep or thermal property is inferred.
